About.metadataDescription: Academic background, professional focus, and technical domains of Younass Ibn Abdeslam.
About.title: Building a practical foundation in cybersecurity.
About.introduction: I am Younass Ibn Abdeslam, an engineering student at ENSA Fès, USMBA, in the Cybersecurity & Digital Development Engineering programme. I am interested in understanding, assessing, and improving the security of systems and infrastructure.
About.academicTitle: Engineering studies focused on cybersecurity and digital development.
About.domainsTitle: Areas of practice and technical development.
About.offensiveSecurityItems: Web application security testing|Penetration testing|Reconnaissance|Vulnerability assessment
About.governanceItems: NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0|Cyber-risk assessment|Security audits|Supplier cybersecurity risk
About.skillNote: These domains represent areas of practice and ongoing development, not a claim of expert-level proficiency in every listed technology.
About.approachTitle: Understand the system before trying to secure it.
About.approachDescription: I like to map how components connect, identify what each part trusts, and then test assumptions in a controlled scope. In both security work and software projects, I value clear evidence, careful documentation, and changes that can be explained and reviewed.

Experience.metadataDescription: Cybersecurity, GRC, and software development internship experience of Younass Ibn Abdeslam.
Experience.title: Practical experience across cybersecurity, GRC, and development.
Experience.introduction: Selected internships where I contributed to security assessment, governance, and software development work.
Experience.cimarSummary: Contributed to web application security assessment and cybersecurity governance work in an internship setting.
Experience.cimarAssessment: Assessed an ASP.NET application using methodologies inspired by OWASP WSTG, OWASP Top 10, ASVS, and API Security Top 10.
Experience.cimarTools: Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Semgrep, Nmap, Gobuster, ffuf, and Nikto.
Experience.cimarGovernance: Contributed to the NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 and gained exposure to supplier cybersecurity risk assessment and governance processes.
Experience.cimarResults: Three Medium findings were identified, with no High or Critical findings. This included an open redirect vulnerability (CWE-601, CVSS 6.1), alongside validation issues that were identified and addressed.
Experience.cimarScopeNote: This was an internship contribution to the work, not ownership of the entire security programme. No confidential infrastructure, application details, supplier information, or non-public procedures are disclosed.
Experience.macobateSummary: Developed a Python-based attendance application for an environment involving more than 100 employees.
Experience.macobateDetails: Used DeepFace and MediaPipe and integrated the application with Odoo ERP.
Experience.macobateScopeNote: The description reflects the verified internship work without adding unconfirmed deployment or performance claims.
